schema.description: Represents a Lambda durable execution, which is a long-running, checkpoint-based execution of a durable function.

FunctionName.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function.

DurableExecutionArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the durable execution.

DurableExecutionName.description: The name of the durable execution.

EndTimestamp.description: The date and time when the durable execution ended, in ISO 8601 format.

FunctionArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Lambda function that was invoked to start this durable execution.

FunctionName.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function. Used as a filter for the List operation.

StartTimestamp.description: The date and time when the durable execution started, in ISO 8601 format.

Status.description: The current status of the durable execution.

Version.description: The version of the Lambda function that was invoked for this durable execution.
